title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R

creators.name: Rodrigues, Hugo
creators.affiliation: University of Florida, Institute of Food and Agricultural Sciences, Range Cattle Research and Education Center, Ona, Florida, USA

description: R package that downloads and reads the Florida Pasture Cube (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24542431): pasture fields as sf objects, 5-day composites of HLS, Sentinel-1 and PRISM with gap-filled optical values removed by default, per-acquisition observation tables and drought, pasture condition and hurricane labels, with helpers for county drought classes, field anomalies and plots.
